scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client ci && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build:server: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build:vercel: npm --prefix client ci && npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
